Quest name: Alternate hagiology (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: London Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Search, r8 Theology, r6 Unlock
Pre-requisite discovery: Heimskringla discovery (from "The circle of the world" quest) + The life records of a saint discovery (from "The memories of saints" quest)
Additional notes: "Aftermath" part of Vinland questchain
